architecture: Buddy -> 65 MasterBots -> sub-bots -> capabilities/tools/resources -> sandbox -> benchmarks -> gap closure

placement_rules.primary_owner: Every bot has exactly one primary MasterBot owner.
placement_rules.secondary_collaborators: Cross-domain capabilities use collaborator links rather than duplicate bot ownership.
placement_rules.preserve_source: Grok AGI, Bots App, Real Estate and repository-specific bots remain traceable to their source.
placement_rules.mastery_truth: A capability is mastered only after repeatable benchmark evidence is recorded.
placement_rules.promotion: A sub-bot strategy is promoted when it produces measurable, reproducible improvement without unacceptable regressions.
placement_rules.runtime: Use GitHub Actions legally and efficiently with matrix parallelism, sharding, caching, artifact reuse and priority queues; never evade platform limits.

sub_bot_policy.rule: Every discovered bot is inventoried, assigned one primary owner, linked to secondary collaborators, benchmarked where applicable, and retained as a source lineage record even when its implementation is consolidated into a stronger superbot.

dashboard_contract.truth: Buttons must invoke real workflows or report unavailable wiring; they must never be decorative claims of execution.

runtime_policy.objective: Maximize useful benchmark-gap closure per available runner-minute.
runtime_policy.constraint: Do not evade GitHub quotas, misuse public runners, or create redundant jobs solely to inflate run counts.
